question: Which one of the following is called a super-network or meta-network?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Internet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A supernetwork,** sometimes known as a supernet, is an **Internet Protocol (IP) network** created by combining numerous networks (or subnets) into a single bigger network.
 
• The integrated network's new routing prefix encapsulates the constituent networks in a single routing table entry.
 
• Supernetting, prefix aggregation, route aggregation, or route summarization are all terms used to describe the process of creating a supernet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Internet** is a global network of interconnected computer networks that communicate with one another using the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP).
 
• **A server** is a programme or equipment that delivers a service to another programme and its user, also known as the client. 
 
• **A metropolitan area network (MAN)** is a computer network that connects computers in a metropolitan region, which can be a single large metropolis, a collection of cities and towns, or any significant area with several buildings.
 
• **A local area network (LAN) **is a computer network that links computers in a certain geographic region, such as a home, school, laboratory, university campus, or office building.
